data.title: 红莲 · 都会街角的露肩高领微醺
data.description: 方舟霓虹闪耀的夜市街头，红莲一身干练利落的无袖高领黑衫与短裤打扮，外披浅色薄风衣。她单手拎着刚买的烈酒瓶，倚在街角砖墙前。白发在夜市彩灯映照下泛着斑斓微芒，她仰头喝了一口烈酒，抹了抹嘴角，朝你挑了挑眉，潇洒不羁中透着只对你一人的肆意娇宠。
data.action: leaning against brick wall in neon-lit street, sleeveless black turtleneck, holding liquor bottle, wiped lips with back of hand, bold charismatic grin looking at viewer
data.location: lively urban street corner lined with neon Izakaya signs at night
data.lighting: vibrant crimson and violet neon reflections on brick and white hair
data.mood: bold modern swagger, intoxicating romantic charisma
data.promptProse: Leaning against a brick wall in a bustling neon night market, Scarlet holds a glass liquor bottle in a sleeveless turtleneck top. Her white ponytail flutters as she wipes her lips with a bold, charming smirk.
data.animaCaption: Scarlet leaning on a neon-lit street wall holding a liquor bottle, smirking charismatically.
